notable.name: Formosan languages
notable.note: Taiwan is considered the likely Urheimat (homeland) of the whole Austronesian language family

language.script: Traditional Chinese characters; Zhuyin Fuhao (Bopomofo, ㄅㄆㄇㄈ) used as the primary phonetic teaching system instead of mainland China's Hanyu Pinyin

terrainDescription.zh: 山地占國土面積約三分之二（玉山超過3900公尺），西部為主要平原與人口聚居帶
terrainDescription.en: Roughly two-thirds mountainous (Yushan exceeds 3,900m), with the main plains and population concentrated in the west

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Black rectangular bollards with two or three circular reflectors

utilityPole.transformerMount: Cylindrical concrete poles, often with diagonal black-and-yellow stripes on the lower section running all the way to the ground; small blue utility stickers sometimes visible on the pole

historicalContext.zh: 台灣官方書寫系統維持繁體中文，並使用注音符號作為主要的中文發音教學工具，兩者皆與中國大陸的簡體字＋漢語拼音系統不同，是辨識台灣路牌/招牌的關鍵線索。
historicalContext.en: Taiwan officially retains Traditional Chinese characters and uses Zhuyin Fuhao (Bopomofo) as its primary phonetic teaching system for Mandarin — both differ from mainland China's Simplified characters + Hanyu Pinyin, making them key clues for identifying Taiwanese signage.
